name: Dirania Silvershine
summary: In Shadowglen, Dirania Silvershine keeps watch over the grove and worries for Iverron. Loyal and observant, she looks out for her companion when his reckless ventures put him in peril.

sections.title: A Watcher in Shadowglen
sections.body: Dirania watches over Shadowglen, a quiet vale beneath Teldrassil's boughs. Young night elves begin their service to Kalimdor and the Alliance here. While others in the barrow mounds and sanctuaries tend to wider spiritual duties, Dirania keeps her attention on those closest to her. Even in Teldrassil's heart, quiet dangers stir.

sections.title: A Friend's Peril
sections.body: Dirania's chief concern is her companion Iverron. Eager and careless around the poisonous creatures that creep through the glen, he often gets into trouble. When a webwood spider's venomous bite fells him, Dirania seeks willing hands to gather ingredients and prepare a remedy before the venom causes lasting harm.

faq.answer: Dirania Silvershine is a night elf in Shadowglen on Teldrassil. She asks for help rescuing and curing Iverron after poisonous wildlife puts him in danger.

faq.q: Where can I find Dirania Silvershine?
faq.answer: You can find Dirania in Shadowglen, the starting vale inside Teldrassil, near the central path by Aldrassil.

faq.q: What is Dirania's relationship to Iverron?
faq.answer: Dirania and Iverron are close friends. She watches over him and arranges an antidote when his careless ways lead to a poisonous bite from local creatures.
Dirania asks travelers to help her companion, including by gathering ingredients for a cure to Iverron's spider venom. Her requests include 'A Friend in Need' and 'Iverron's Antidote'.

faq.q: Why is Dirania worried about spiders in Shadowglen?
faq.answer: Webwood spiders in Shadowglen's boughs carry potent venom. Novice elves like Iverron often underestimate the danger of their bites, though experienced sentinels can handle the spiders.

faq.q: Does Dirania belong to any formal order or faction?
faq.answer: Dirania is an Alliance night elf living in Teldrassil. She is not shown as an active member of the Sisterhood of Elune or the Cenarion Circle, but as a civilian who cares for her kin.

angles.text: As a young night elf entering Shadowglen, you can see through Dirania how friendship matters and how danger reaches even the newest sanctuaries of the World Tree.
